data.name: Aaniyah
data.gender_notes: Aaniyah is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Captive; subdued; subservient (for the spelling عانية)
data.long_meaning: The spelling عانية (ʿāniya) is the active participle of the Arabic root ع-ن-و (ʿ-n-w), 'to be subdued, to submit', giving 'captive; subdued; subservient'. The different spelling آنية (āniya) is a separate word meaning 'vessel, container' (and, in Qur'anic usage, 'intense heat'). The two spellings must not be merged. Its root is ع-ن-و (ʿ-n-w). Aaniyah is a Arabic name meaning “Captive; subdued; subservient (for the spelling عانية)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaniyah expresses “Captive; subdued; subservient (for the spelling عانية)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The spelling عانية (ʿāniya) is the active participle of the Arabic root ع-ن-و (ʿ-n-w), 'to be subdued, to submit', giving 'captive; subdued; subservient'. The different spelling آنية (āniya) is a separate word meaning 'vessel, container' (and, in Qur'anic usage, 'intense heat'). The two spellings must not be merged.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaniyah total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
